params.message:
Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg are regions under Benelux (0.19.0)

The finest region that held Belgium was Benelux, so an engine asked for the
most specific region of a Belgian signal had no narrower answer, and a
Flemish or Belgian reading could not be made. The three countries are added
under Benelux; be, nl and lu now match the country. Flanders and Wallonia
are spellings of Belgium, not regions: language tells them apart.

Portal: De Gentells Standard krijgt België, Nederland en Luxemburg als eigen regio onder Benelux.
